title: I designed a factory game using Claude as Code Assistant
author: Disagreeg
selftext:
Earth ReGen is a node-based automation game about cleaning up a dead planet. You start by picking up rubbish by hand, then place machines and wire them together with workforce, power and materials. Trash becomes metal, batteries and power plants, and each place you clean slowly turns green again. Free demo in the browser: [https://disagreeg.itch.io/earth-regen](https://disagreeg.itch.io/earth-regen)

Claude wrote all the code. I did the idea, design, the balance and the testing and most part of the text.

Happy to answer questions about the workflow and read some feedback.
